posts.title: Idealab’s Bill Gross just AI-ed himself. He says the bot might create 100 million new jobs by 2036.
posts.description: I’ve known Bill Gross for more than 25 years. He’s an irrepressible idea machine. It’s why his Pasadena tech incubator is called Idealab.
